report.notes: R4-01: class-based stems per word (with readable-word strip), joined-name phrases, and an alphanumeric 3-32 char value fallback for names or labels ending in code/pin/key, identical in redact.py and snapshot.js. The corpus is independent of the rule list and is checked in Python, real Chromium and the assist_ask Brain body. AC7 in A0_QUALIFICATION is restated as pattern-based with residual risk L-A0-2 and a recorded correction; unknown fields still fail open (fail-closed not adopted, owner may decide). R4-02: magnitudes multiplied out, units kept and normalised in evaluate.numbers, so verify and conflicts are both fixed; the existing R1 expectation '1250.50' is preserved. R4-03: per-hop watchdog shuts sockets down via a wrapped httpcore network backend at the deadline or on cancel, and connect is capped at the remaining budget; reviewer probes now stop at 1.0 s (were 67.3 s and 12.1 s). On a copy of the repo at 1615512 with only the new tests added, 209 new test cases fail and only the controls pass. tests/assist plus tests/web: 2260 passed with the fix. graphify was not available, so the graph was not updated.
